tasks.spec: Per phase brief. CLI with --once. Sequence: db.connect(); market_data.batch_refresh(active_holdings + benchmarks, total_retry_budget_s from a module const); WEEKLY branch (only when date.weekday()==6 or --weekly) does gap-only price_history refresh per symbol MAX(date)+1..today with INSERT OR IGNORE; placeholder local-LLM review; new snapshots row per day; data_health UPDATE WHERE id=1; compress agent_memory older than 90d; write research_notes; copy finance.db -> backend/data/backups/finance_YYYYMMDD.db keeping the newest 7. Schedule note in a comment (Task Scheduler 23:00 IST).

Steps, each exit-non-zero on failure: (1) npm --prefix frontend run build; (2) rm/clean backend/static/; (3) copytree frontend/out -> backend/static. Print each step. This is the ONLY export path (no next export).

Open the db via services.db; run EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on 'SELECT * FROM latest_prices' and assert the plan uses idx_price_history_symbol_date (string 'idx_price_history_symbol_date' in the plan). Print the plan. Exit non-zero if the index is not used.

REWRITE finance-os/backend/main.py keeping everything from Phase 0 (startup init_db + encrypted-volume warning + auth passthrough + /api/finance routers + GET /api/finance/health) and ENSURING: StaticFiles(directory=here/'static', html=True) mounted at '/' when static/ exists; a catch-all GET '/{full_path:path}' that returns FileResponse(static/<full_path>.html) if it exists, else FileResponse(static/<full_path>/index.html), else FileResponse(static/index.html), else 404 - so deep links like /finance/investments resolve to Next's investments.html. Do not shadow /api/finance/*. This file is self-contained; do not assume you can read the old one - reconstruct it fully from the Phase 0 brief + this spec.

A short human checklist for making finance-os THE Finance screen (the one manual step after the autonomous build passes): (1) in Start_Inky/serve_everything_on_one_port.py, point the Finance route at `uvicorn main:app` from finance-os/backend + its static bundle, and stop mounting Screens/Finance/server_for_finance.py (leave the tree in git history); (2) if the served path changed, update the Finance target in Main_Menu/Page/next_app/app/components/NavPanel.tsx; (3) run finance-os/build.py; (4) smoke Start_Inky/Start_Everything.bat. List the exact lines to change if you can infer them from the current serve file.
